title: There were 2,524 white students enrolled in Westlake City School District in 2023-24 school year
text:
Paul Craft Ohio Superintendent of Public Instruction | https://sboe.ohio.gov/about-us/superintendent/01-superintendent
Paul Craft Ohio Superintendent of Public Instruction | https://sboe.ohio.gov/about-us/superintendent/01-superintendent
Ohio Department of Education & Workforce.
Data showed that Westlake City School District welcomed 3,264 students during the 2023-24 school year. Among them, white students made up 77.3% of the student body, making them the most represented ethnicity in the district.
Westlake City School District roughly covers four schools within Cuyahoga County and has its main office in Westlake.
Among the four schools in Westlake City School District, Westlake Elementary School recorded the highest enrollment of white students in the 2023-24 school year, with a total of 945 students.
In 2022, Ohio saw an average student-to-teacher ratio of approximately 1:15, which is better than the national average of 1:16. This marks an improvement for the state, especially compared to 2016, when the ratio reached its decade-high at 16.1 students per teacher.
Despite the apparent improvement, this positive trend is overshadowed by a general decline in public school enrollments, which was accelerated by the pandemic. This decline, aligned with the steady number of teachers in the state over the last 10 years, has led to low student-to-teacher ratios.
Year | Total District Enrollment | Total White Students | White % |
---|---|---|---|
2023-24 | 3,264 | 2,524 | 77.3% |
2022-23 | 3,251 | 2,516 | 77.4% |
2021-22 | 3,282 | 2,574 | 78.4% |
